about_short_description.short_description: Acoustical Engineering & Research (aer) is a sound and acoustic-based consulting, engineering, research and development services company.

product.name: Acoustic Consulting for New Constructions
product.description: Provides acoustic studies and implementation for new buildings, including those with high environmental standards.

product.name: Acoustic Treatment of Rooms
product.description: Designs and implements acoustic treatments for performance and conference rooms to optimize sound quality and control noise.

product.name: Acoustic Camera Diagnostics
product.description: Uses a 40-microphone acoustic camera to map noise sources and acoustic leaks in real time with high precision.

product.name: Building and Construction Acoustics
product.description: Offers acoustic solutions related to building acoustics, room acoustics, and construction site noise management.

product.name: Industrial and Environmental Noise Control
product.description: Conducts noise source attenuation and environmental noise impact studies for industrial and environmental settings.

product.name: Vibration Treatment and Electroacoustic Design
product.description: Provides vibration control, sound design, and electroacoustic engineering for objects and machinery.
